name: drawio-scientific-illustrator
description: Control the live draw.io canvas through draw.io's own graph API so users can watch diagrams appear step by step from a description, then save, validate, and export them.

interface.shortDescription: Draw diagrams live inside draw.io from your description through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects a localhost-only MCP channel directly to draw.io's own graph API. From a text description or requirements, shapes, labels, connectors, styling, movement, resizing, and zoom changes appear immediately in the visible draw.io canvas with adjustable pacing. It does not control the operating-system mouse or keyboard and does not need to pre-generate XML before drawing. Afterward it can save, validate, and export editable deliverables.
defaultPrompt: 根据我的描述，在可见的 draw.io 画布中逐步绘制这张图。
Draw this diagram live in draw.io, step by step, from my description.
Inspect and refine the current live draw.io diagram.
